hooks.text: 三百多名角色分属五大阵营，展开全阵营战争
hooks.excerpt: There are over 300 super unique characters in the game! Five factions including the Regular Army, Rebel Army, Space Army, and more wage all-out war!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 操作易上手但难精通，自选角色构筑专属牌组
hooks.excerpt: The controls make it so that anyone can have fun playing! Gameplay is easy, but hard to master! Train your favorite characters and build your unique deck!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 长篇后续故事之外，还能在画廊欣赏美术与音乐
hooks.excerpt: “ANOTHER STORY” follows the characters in a lengthy sequel to the story, and “GALLERY” Mode allows you to view art and listen to the music in the game!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
